content:
{'index': 0, 'translation': 'Earlier this month, OpenAI, together with Astra, launched its first GPT-6 model. The GPT-6 series officially debuts, adding two new model variants—GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna—further expanding the product lineup.'}

{'index': 1, 'translation': 'GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are available starting today.'}

{'index': 2, 'translation': 'According to the update notes for the ChatGPT desktop app, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna consume fewer tokens compared to the corresponding GPT-5.6 versions.'}

{'index': 3, 'translation': 'GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna will be available on Codex and ChatGPT Work, with token pricing lower than the previous-generation GPT-5.6. Sol is suited for complex coding and agentic workflows, while Luna is designed for tasks requiring high focus and high throughput. The two models will be rolled out in phases to Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu users. Free users and Go users can access Luna through the desktop app. Actual availability will depend on the phased rollout schedule and workspace settings; Enterprise admins will need to enable the new models themselves. Within ChatGPT, the two models are currently available only on Work and Codex, and have not yet arrived on Chat.'}

{'index': 4, 'translation': 'Worth noting: there is no such thing as GPT-6 Terra. It appears OpenAI is gradually phasing out mid-tier models, keeping only three tiers: Terra (small), Sol (large), and Astra (extra-large).'}

{'index': 5, 'translation': 'Below is the official announcement from OpenAI:'}

{'index': 6, 'translation': "Even though the most challenging and high-impact tasks still require the full depth of Astra, different tasks come with different scale, pace, and budget considerations. In light of this, we are extending the GPT-6 series and proudly introducing GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna. GPT-6 Astra pioneered a new generation of intelligence, and these two new models further improve cost-effectiveness, bringing those advantages to a broader user base. We trained GPT-6 Sol and Luna using the same method used to train GPT-6 Astra, distilling Astra's leading capabilities in professional work, factual accuracy, coding, computer use, and model alignment into faster, more economical models."}

{'index': 7, 'translation': 'The company said both new models outperform GPT-5.6 and are priced lower than Astra (as well as the GPT-5.6 versions they replace). For example, the Sol and Luna versions of GPT-6 are priced 50% lower than their GPT-5.6 counterparts.'}
